attestations.note: The life page `https://www.saint.gr/2790/saint.aspx` heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 23 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and is one citation and one couplet. Charsianon, the theme in Cappadocia where his monastery stood, is named without a year and no coordinate is proposed. None of the eleven Nicephorus folders the corpus already holds is a founder of that house or kept on this day. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page.
